ThingDef.label: flood trigger
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. The canyon flood enters here and runs along the dug channel beside it, on the map's flood clock or from its button, on any biome. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built. Its clock, spill, size and on/off are set from its buttons in development mode.

ThingDef.label: soak zone
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. The square of ground around it stays soaked for a set number of hours each day, so plants there grow as they do after a flood. Works only where Plant Growth runs (Baroque Biomes' own biomes). Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built. Its size, hours and on/off are set from its buttons in development mode.
